lead: All lights on amber: caution, a possible bottom.
note: Crypto mood is extreme fear (12), Bitcoin's RSI is 27 (oversold) and it trades 52% below its record. It is still 14% above its average-cost line of $53,033. The US dollar is strong, a headwind for crypto and gold.
